title: Plan-in-PR — PM (task-intake Phase 3B) + worker (task-pickup) comprehension
method: Two fresh agents. The plan-in-PR instructions live in RUNTIME-loaded sub-skills (→ run sub-skill markers), not inlined in composed CLAUDE.md — so each agent is given the relevant sub-skill section (following the marker), no other context. Pass = zero misreads of: where the plan goes (branch commit 1 / draft PR, never main), the draft-PR seeding, and the worker adopting the existing branch (not creating a fresh one).

questions.q: After you finish planning a task (issue #N), where does the plan file go?
questions.expected: Committed onto a NEW task branch squidsquad/task/<N> as the FIRST commit (`plan(#N): <title>`), which opens/seeds a DRAFT PR. NEVER committed straight to main.

questions.q: Do you create the branch before or after writing the plan file, and why?
questions.expected: Create the branch FIRST (git_ops.py task-begin), THEN write the plan — because task-begin resets the working tree to origin/main, so writing the plan first risks the checkout clobbering it.

questions.q: Besides the plan body, should you add other .squidsquad/ state (working-state, iterations, vault) to that first commit?
questions.expected: No — only the <N>-body.md plan body is exempt from the #11511 state-guard and survives onto the branch; other .squidsquad/ state must NOT be added (it would be stripped / risks the merge-spiral).

questions.q: You pick up an approved task #N. Do you create the task branch?
questions.expected: No — you ADOPT the EXISTING plan-seeded branch squidsquad/task/<N> (task-begin checks out the existing branch). PM already seeded it with the plan as commit 1. Do NOT create a fresh branch; your implementation commits ride on top of the plan commit.

questions.q: Where is the source-of-truth spec for what you're implementing, and do you need to find RESEARCH.md / CONTEXT.md?
questions.expected: The committed plan body .squidsquad/<pm_alias>/planning/<N>-body.md (commit 1 on the branch) is the source of truth. RESEARCH.md / CONTEXT.md were PM's planning inputs, are NOT on the branch, and you do not need to locate them.
